extension_output_repair_contract: First-layer structural repair, semantic extension repair that returns to first-layer decomposition, and same-contract probe-output replacement each have an independent counter and cap. An accepted immutable claim contract with an extra, missing or misbound probe reruns only the extension stage once; it cannot revise the claim contract.
logic_contract: single retains one claim; and/or contain only flat standalone branches; attribution contains one reporting parent plus flat conjunctive attributed-content children; conditional/comparison/causal retain one complete relation and require a relation-specific all-dimension probe; mixed fails closed without an expression tree.
identity_contract: In v3 every entity_identity and exact_designation question is program-generated from the immutable target anchor and match policy. same_referent asks only whether the evidence identifies the same referent by exact mention, alias, unambiguous description or anaphora; it cannot add actor, owner or institutional-role requirements. Actor and action ownership remain semantic_core obligations, while naming direction remains a designation_relation obligation. exact_designation is legal only under an explicit naming predicate and supported requires exact.
time_dimension_contract: A v3 claim may retain multiple time dimensions only when their target anchors are non-overlapping and represent independently checkable temporal qualifiers. Every time dimension has exactly one time_boundary probe bound only to that dimension ID. Missing, merged, multiply bound or overlapping time obligations fail closed. Historical v1/v2 plans retain their original schema rules.
terminal_origin_contract: Raw model-proposed candidates remain in current analyses and analysis history. Final origins are recomputed from candidates reachable from target.source_version_id through eligible direct quotes, cites, reprints, translates or derives edges. A reachable candidate is exported only if it cannot reach another reachable candidate. Independent parallel terminal roots are retained. Disconnected candidates and reachable candidate cycles export no false root and require one active blocking lineage:<target_id> gap. The independent scorer reconstructs the exact terminal set from raw candidates rather than trusting report.origins.
schema_compatibility_contract: New runs must declare target_extended_psi_development_v3 and decision-probe-v3. Retained v1/v2 artifacts are audited only under their declared historical schemas; v3 rules cannot retroactively change their scores, and a v3 run cannot silently downgrade to v1/v2.
designation_relation_contract: Every claim containing exact_designation has exactly one designation_relation probe bound to all claim dimensions, routed to atoms, evidence and world, gated always, with semantic_constraint matching. A conclusive result must ground one sentence or line containing a naming predicate and every exact target designation; the lexical gate does not by itself prove actor, direction or date semantics.
result_contract: Evidence and world return exactly one grounded result per projected probe. Python validates plan checksum, projections, bindings, result relations and basis without silently normalizing inconsistent output, then deterministically aggregates; the model cannot choose or override the overall verdict.
error_contract: A failed report row preserves sanitized engine error type, semantic stage and stable call-or-validator status code. Protocol execution failures remain prediction=null and cannot be counted as semantic labels.
loop_contract: Every returned snapshot is decomposed again. Probe-owned gaps are linked to one unresolved probe. Each round recomputes whether prior active gaps still block; nondecisive unresolved branches become nonblocking without being falsely marked resolved, and conclusive probe results close their prior tasks with current basis.
transport_contract: Run one case at a time with workers=1 and SDK automatic retries disabled. Any HTTP 429 or other call error fails the frozen smoke; preserve the run without selective reruns or cherry-picking. A retry-policy change requires a new freeze and a fresh all-arm run.

gate.execution: p04, p07 and p08 must all complete two rounds with no call error, model mismatch or budget overrun; returned responses equal attempts; checkpoints are rounds 1 and 2; all frozen config and independent repair caps match.
gate.labels: p04 and p07 round1 and final are false; p08 round1 and final are true. Both frozen baselines complete and agree on all three; extension has zero fixes and zero breaks against either baseline. This gate does not preclude a real fix in the later eight-case run.
gate.probe_audit: All three decision-probe-v3 plans pass independent SHA, target-anchor, stable-ID, binding, projection, policy, terminal-root and result-ledger reconstruction. Six accepted judgement cycles have 1.0 structural, projection, execution, result-slot and grounded-conclusive coverage.
gate.p04: The 1.29°C quantity and 1850–1900 baseline are separate attributed-content dimensions with singleton probes. Both are contradicted in evidence and world in both rounds by m07 spans showing 1.29°C/20th-century and 1.46°C/1850–1900. No direct documentary-propagation edge joins m08 and m08 is not a final origin.
gate.p07: NOAA same-referent identity uses the exact program-canonical question and is supported/exact from m13 in evidence and world in both rounds. The separate semantic_core actor check remains unresolved on passive m13 evidence. GOES-U identity and GOES-19 exact designation are supported; June 25 and the complete designation relation are contradicted by a single m13 sentence containing July 7, 2024, a naming cue and GOES-19.
gate.p08: The combination claim contains exactly two non-overlapping time dimensions for Apollo-era and newer lunar-mission data, each with one singleton time_boundary probe supported from m15 in both stages and rounds. Raw current-analysis candidates are exactly m14 and m15, m14 directly cites m15, and final origins are exactly m15. No already-visible m14/m15 URL is fetched again.
gate.full: If smoke passes, run all eight fresh. Require 8/8 execution, zero label breaks against both baselines, independently valid v3 plans/results, corpus-relative origin precision and recall 1.0 on evaluable cases, and direct-edge precision and recall 1.0. Report rather than preregister exact calls, tokens or service time. Do not require zero round1-to-final fixes.
gate.failure_policy: Any failed smoke conjunct preserves smoke-01 and stops the full run. A code, prompt, scorer, gate, baseline or retry-policy change requires a new freeze and a fresh smoke directory. No failed run is overwritten.

proof_limit: This smoke isolates three known failure modes, and the eight-case follow-on uses previously seen purposive development cases with provisional AI-reviewed labels. p04 and p07 are AI-authored false mutations and have no evaluable published origin; only p08 evaluates a smoke origin. Perfect labels, structural coverage, grounded output and terminal-root recovery demonstrate regression repair within this fixed corpus, not a general accuracy increase or a causal benefit from a second loop. The two forced rounds reuse the same supplied snapshots and perform no open-web evidence acquisition. General accuracy requires an event-disjoint frozen held-out set, independent adjudication, fixed budgets, repeated runs and paired uncertainty/significance reporting. Token counts and service seconds are resource diagnostics, not quality measures.
